cycles.method: Authored instructions of the sequencer-tick hook (dj_land) per tick, priced at 16 core cycles each (the conservative ColdFire V4 envelope Quant Live Rec's record uses); the stock routines it calls (Program Change, the kernel post, the trig-condition reset) are stock cost and are excluded from both figures. Static: 5,700, an upper bound counted from patch_directjump_v7.s for the dearest tick, a cue that lands on the tick that arms it: the arming path with the 16-track parameter pass (each track's gcd at most 8 Euclid steps, every scale's ticks per step dividing 48) and one scan step, then the landing with the parameter pass again, the 16-track snapshot, three 24-slot purge tables, three posts and the hand-off. Measured on the module-alone native image (MAIN OS 9af03715…) under ot_emu --mkii, 24 Oct 2026: PC watches on dj_land's entry and return and on both sides of each stock call, cues at four phases of the step on a 16-step, a 7-step (Part 2) and a PER TRACK pattern (tracks from 2x to 1/8x): 2,946 authored instructions at most (3,166 with the stock calls), on a cue landing on its arming tick; an ordinary landing tick 2,133, idle ticks about 35 ON and 18 OFF. Budget: the code runs in the sequencer tick interrupt (level 3, below the level-5 DSP frame interrupt, which preempts it), so its deadline is the next tick: one tick at the Octatrack's top tempo of 300 BPM is 8.33 ms, 2,200,000 cycles at 264 MHz. The static bound also fits one 362.8 us frame (95,778). Not chip timing. 0.1.1-experimental: the Direct Jump unit is byte-identical (the same reference SHA-256 2965bf7d…), so these per-tick figures are 0.1.0's measurement, carried over, not re-measured. The added MIDI Plays-Free fix is not on the tick path: it replaces stock's five-instruction per-track scale seed in a track's start routine with at most thirteen, the jmp included (ten for an audio track), once per track start. 0.1.2-experimental changes only the package's title: the same figures.

load.method: Emulator, not hardware: ot_emu --mkii --dsp --frame (the ColdFire port, upstream:tools build, SHA-256 bdbe962c…), 24 Oct 2026. Two native static-stock images: the original MAIN OS and the module-alone image above, Direct Jump ON. The same 62 s on both from PLAY: one three-byte message every ms (notes on and off and CCs on channels 1-8, about 1,000 a second) plus a MIDI clock byte every 10 ms (about 250 BPM), A02 edited in RAM to 7 steps on Part 2, a cue every second alternating A01 and A02, and STOP then PLAY at 7, 22, 37 and 52 s. Longest frame interrupt: the most instructions between the frame handler's entry (watched at 0x4000aad4, the port reports no hit on its first instruction) and its epilogue 0x4000d9a6 over 174115 frames, priced in the port's own time (3,990 instructions a sample, so one is 362.8 / 63,840 us): 29434 stock, 29442 with the module. Idle: the port's own share, 100 x (1 - executed instructions / (3,990 x elapsed samples)). The module's tick work runs in the level-3 sequencer tick interrupt, which the frame interrupt preempts. Measured on the 0.1.0 image and carried over for 0.1.1: the frame interrupt and the MIDI handlers are untouched by the added Plays-Free fix, and the Direct Jump unit is byte-identical.

stress.droppedExplanation: Emulator, not hardware, the run above on the module image with Direct Jump ON: 62,000 three-byte messages and 6,200 clock bytes; 62 cues gave 62 jumps (63 pattern changes with the first), the original OS under the same input changed pattern 5 times (each cue waits for the pattern end). Dropped: counted at the MIDI thread's handlers (note on 0x4000e018, note off 0x4000db98, CC 0x4000e79c, clock 0x40005a48): every type's entries were at least the messages sent (up to two more on some types, as on the original OS under the same input: the PC watch counting an entry twice), none missing. Stuck notes: no samples are loaded and no MIDI track plays notes in this project, and nothing was sent to MIDI OUT, so audible stuck notes could not occur here. Hangs: frames advanced to the end (174,115 frame interrupts) and the transport was still running. Bypass: the module's OFF state is checked in the gate (verify.py), not in this run.
